name: ChoiceWise Editorial Team
bio: The ChoiceWise editorial team researches, compares and scores products using a consistent, published methodology. Every guide is fact-checked and updated regularly.

name: Alex Morgan
bio: Alex has covered consumer electronics for over a decade, with a focus on audio, laptops and smart home gear. Alex leads ChoiceWise's tech testing and scoring framework.

name: Jordan Lee
bio: Jordan reviews kitchen appliances, cleaning gear and pet tech, comparing everyday usability, maintenance costs and long-term reliability.

name: Sam Rivera
bio: Sam evaluates VPNs, password managers and online services, with a background in network engineering and privacy policy analysis.
